name: Oguni (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Oguni town emblem in green: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain peak.
history: Municipal flag of Oguni, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 November 1962.

features.role: Oguni town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain peak
